sentiment: Some things we make grow larger than we can hold; others we carry gently, hands steady, hoping nothing we built hurts anyone.

stories.title: Mistral Large 4
stories.summary: Another leap in capability, announced like weather. The models keep getting bigger faster than the rooms we put them in — impressive, and a little hard to hold.

stories.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.summary: Machines beginning to move through proof the way we move through language. Beautiful, and worth asking what we still want to do by hand.

stories.title: The art of defusing a second world war bomb
stories.summary: Eighty years later, old things we built still sleep under our streets, and careful hands still go down to meet them. Patience as a form of protection.
